name: late-night-laptop-selfie
image_vibe: Dim nocturnal bedroom, cool screen glow, raw smartphone realism
image_purpose: Create a realistic laptop-screen photograph showing a candid Photo Booth selfie and music interface context.

prompt.project_info: A raw smartphone photograph of a MacBook screen, not a screenshot, showing a late-night bedroom Photo Booth preview.
prompt.main_subject: The approved adult person from the required identity reference lies down in a relaxed candid pose inside the Photo Booth preview, wearing a light-colored tank top and holding an iPhone 15 Pro in the right hand. Preserve face, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, skin tone, skin texture, hairline, and overall identity without beautification.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle downward view of a MacBook screen filling most of frame with a thin strip of physical keyboard visible. Show visible RGB pixel grid, subtle moire, micro dust, fingerprints, ambient reflections, macOS dark mode, Spotify Liked Songs in the background, and a floating Photo Booth live-preview window at center-right.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dim bedroom inside the Photo Booth preview with off-white wall, rumpled bedding, cool screen glow mixed with warm skin tones, low-light nocturnal atmosphere, and realistic glass reflections.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 frame, 1152x1536 target, raw smartphone photo of a screen, natural noise, imperfect glass, no studio lighting, no HD polish, realistic screen moire and pixel structure.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 3:4 raw smartphone photograph of a MacBook screen, not a screenshot. The MacBook screen fills most of the frame with a thin strip of physical keyboard visible, showing an RGB pixel grid, subtle moire, micro dust, faint fingerprints, and soft ambient reflections. Use macOS dark mode with Spotify Liked Songs in the background showing Blank Space, Shake It Off, Cruel Summer, and Love Story by Taylor Swift, plus a floating Photo Booth live-preview window at center-right. Inside the Photo Booth preview, show the approved adult person from the required identity reference lying down in a relaxed candid pose in a dim bedroom with an off-white wall and rumpled bedding, wearing a light-colored tank top and holding an iPhone 15 Pro in the right hand. Preserve face, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, skin tone, skin texture, hairline, and overall identity without beautification. Use cool screen glow mixed with warm skin tones, natural noise, imperfect glass, and authentic raw smartphone realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent tank top, exposed underwear, nudity, altered face, face swap, beauty filter, screenshot, flat UI, perfect screen, clean glass, studio lighting, cartoon, 3D render, painting, watermark, blurred face

assets.name: approved adult identity reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult person's face and overall identity in the Photo Booth preview.

assets.name: screen content reference
assets.usage: Use as the content reference for the visible laptop/Photo Booth screen area; preserve screen shape and content without adding UI beyond the specified macOS/Spotify context.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Both references are required: the first for approved adult identity and the second for screen content. Keep the MacBook screen photograph, bedroom preview, Spotify track context, Photo Booth window, and realistic moire/glass artifacts consistent; non-essential room details may vary.

changes: Clarified approved adult identity references and secure tank-top coverage.
Preserved the two-reference screen-within-screen concept and added safety exclusions.
